apps.name: CCSE Prep
apps.tagline: Preparación para la prueba CCSE de la nacionalidad española. / Prep for Spain's CCSE citizenship test.
apps.applies: the iPhone app and the Android app (version 1.0.0 and later) and this page
apps.audience: adults preparing for Spain's CCSE nationality test
apps.stored: Your answers, mistakes, bookmarks, mock-exam history, readiness, language, exam date and reminder settings

pro.name: CCSE Prep Pro
pro.unlocks: all 300 questions, unlimited mock exams, the full results breakdown and mistakes review, and the AI tutor

ai.sent: the message you type, the question you are asking about (with its answer and explanation) and your chosen language
ai.note: The AI tutor is part of Pro and may not be enabled in every version.

apps.authority: the Instituto Cervantes or the Government of Spain
apps.source_note: The exam questions are those of the free Manual de preparación de la prueba CCSE 2026 published by the Instituto Cervantes.
apps.support_html:
Fuentes · Sources

Las preguntas proceden del Manual de preparación de la prueba CCSE 2026 del Instituto Cervantes, gratuito. Información oficial del examen: examenes.cervantes.es/es/ccse.
apps.disclaimer: CCSE Prep es una app independiente de ANAVASIS LLC: no está afiliada al Instituto Cervantes ni al Gobierno de España. / An independent app by ANAVASIS LLC, not affiliated with the Instituto Cervantes or the Spanish government.

apps.name: AussiePrep
apps.tagline: Practice for the Australian citizenship test, with the Australian values rule built in.
apps.applies: the iPhone app and the Android app (version 1.0.0 and later) and this page
apps.audience: adults preparing for the Australian citizenship test
apps.stored: Your answers, mistakes, mock-test history, readiness, help language and reminder settings

pro.name: AussiePrep Pro
pro.unlocks: all 370 practice questions, unlimited mock tests, all explanations and the AI tutor

ai.sent: the message you type, the earlier messages in that chat, the practice question you are asking about (with its answer, explanation and booklet references) and your chosen help language

apps.authority: the Department of Home Affairs or the Australian Government
apps.source_note: The practice questions are written from the free booklet Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (testable section), published by the Commonwealth of Australia under the CC BY 4.0 licence.
apps.support_html:
Sources

The practice questions are written from the testable section of Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (© Commonwealth of Australia, CC BY 4.0). The Department of Home Affairs also offers a free official practice test.
apps.disclaimer: AussiePrep is an independent app by ANAVASIS LLC. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the Department of Home Affairs or the Australian Government.
